def custom_sort(n, m, books):
    # Create a list of tuples where each tuple contains the index and the book title
    indexed_books = [(i + 1, book) for i, book in enumerate(books)]
    
    # Define the custom key function for sorting
    def custom_key(book):
        index, title = book
        # Sort odd-indexed characters ascendingly and even-indexed characters descendingly
        return [title[j] if j % 2 == 0 else -ord(title[j]) for j in range(m)]
    
    # Sort the indexed books using the custom key function
    sorted_books = sorted(indexed_books, key=custom_key)
    
    # Extract the indices of the sorted books
    sorted_indices = [index for index, _ in sorted_books]
    
    return sorted_indices

# Read input
